overview_description.description:
Fernris Creations is an independent developer of massively multiplayer online (MMO) games. They are creators of boundless and fascinating universes. Their products feature EVE Online, Project M5, and FPS projects.

Since the launch of EVE Online in May 2003, CCP has established itself as a company in the field, winning numerous awards and receiving critical acclaim worldwide.

about_short_description.short_description: Fernris Creations is an independent developer of massively multiplayer games (MMO).

product.name: EVE Online
product.description: A single-shard sandbox massively multiplayer online game set in the New Eden star cluster, where players participate in exploration, commerce, industry, politics, and large-scale space warfare.

product.name: Carbon
product.description: A cross-platform game engine framework used to build and operate large-scale persistent online worlds, with systems for graphics, physics, networking, audio, user interfaces, scripting, and resource management.

product.name: EVE Frontier
product.description: A space survival massively multiplayer online game set in a shattered galaxy, combining resource management, exploration, risk, and player-driven development of the game world.

product.name: EVE Vanguard
product.description: An in-development extraction-adventure first-person shooter set on hostile planets in the EVE Universe, focused on missions, combat, resource recovery, and player influence on a wider war.

product.name: EVE Galaxy Conquest
product.description: A mobile 4X strategy game set in New Eden, featuring exploration, diplomacy, resource management, territorial competition, and player-versus-player battles.

product.name: EVE Echoes
product.description: A mobile sandbox massively multiplayer online game set in an alternate EVE universe, offering space exploration, commerce, combat, and player-driven interaction.
